extracted.intended_audience: readers of social and historical commentary; scholars of race, colonialism, and religion
extracted.subtask_short: historical essay on race and religion
extracted.subtask_description: A literary/historical discussion addressing the moral, social, and religious dimensions of African peoples under colonialism and slavery, responding to contemporary critics. The text surveys examples, historical developments, and social conditions rather than prescribing evaluative criteria for producing or assessing a specific work.
